writing1.title: Writing 1: Chart Description
writing1.prompt: The chart shows students attending memory and study-skills workshops over four weeks. Describe the rise in attendance from 18 to 30 to 38 to 51, include accurate comparisons, and give an overall summary. Write at least 100 words.

writing2.title: Writing 2: Formal Email
writing2.prompt: Write a formal email to your school principal proposing a practical workshop on memory strategies and managing exam worries. Explain its aims, two activities, how students could give feedback and why it would benefit the school. Write at least 100 words.
